name: Basic playback controls moved behind Premium
summary: Free users say the update removed skipping, choosing, replaying and previous-song controls, forced shuffle, and limited skips, pushing them toward Premium.

name: Generic negative sentiment without specific defect
summary: Reviewers call the app bad, worst, disappointing, or trash without naming any specific feature or defect.

name: Excessive, frequent, and loud ads
summary: Customers complain that ads appear too often, sometimes after every one or two songs, and are too loud, making the free experience frustrating.

name: Cannot log in or access account
summary: Customers report the app rejects their password or will not let them into their existing account.

name: App crashes or stuck on loading screen
summary: Users report the app freezes on the loading or logo screen, or crashes after an update so it cannot be opened.

name: Disliked home screen and UI redesign
summary: Customers say recent app updates introduced a home screen and layout redesign they find worse, including unwanted autoplay and difficulty playing or repeating specific song parts.

name: Lyrics missing or inconsistently shown
summary: Customers report lyrics appear for some songs but not others, or fail to display at times.

name: Many songs and genres unavailable
summary: Customers say many songs are absent from the catalog and certain genres, such as gospel, are thin.

name: Recommendations and shuffle feel random or intrusive
summary: Customers complain that playlist playback is random and that the app pushes unwanted recommendations.

name: Downloaded music fails to play offline
summary: Customers report that offline playback does not work and downloaded content cannot be played without internet access.

name: Boycott calls over political or religious content
summary: Some users say they will uninstall or boycott the app because of its country of origin or perceived political and religious stance.

name: Recent update disliked without specifics
summary: Users say a recent update made the app disappointing or useless but do not identify which feature broke.

name: Google Assistant plays playlist without songs
summary: Customers report that Google Assistant announces playing a Spotify playlist but no songs actually play.

name: Wi-Fi connection failures while online
summary: A customer reports being unable to connect to the internet over Wi-Fi when using the app.

name: Playback stops halfway and loses position
summary: Customers report that music keeps stopping partway through, and on resuming it jumps to a new song instead of continuing where it left off.

name: Cannot rewind a few seconds after update
summary: A customer reports that after an update they can no longer go back a few seconds in a track, and threatens to delete the app.

name: Limited skipping through unwanted playlist songs
summary: A customer wants to play a single song but must go through an entire playlist, where skipping is limited to six tracks.

name: Song downloads get stuck in background
summary: Customers report that downloads remain stuck while running in the background.

name: Music adjustment feature not working properly
summary: A customer reports that the music adjustment feature does not work correctly.
